tickets.title: Money learning: a money policy that can be published, and one credit rule online and offline (**amendment 13, E28, 2026-10-28**)

authority.locator: E28 · section 2 of amendment 13, "Done when" (inserted from _evidence/parity-step3/S50/AMENDMENT-13-E28-E29.md; the verification S47/engine, Engine 18, R-P557; in force under the owner's direction, R-P545)
authority.requirement: the learn document carries a money policy (`money`: the currency its money counters are in, and what a value at or below zero means), validated when it is published; both outcome producers and the recovery path pass it on; the money rule sits inside the one credit rule that live learning and every offline fold read, so the report credits exactly what live learning credits; the SDK sends a currency only when the page's data layer names one; kit 02 says how to publish the policy. The policy's values are the tenant's to publish; what a starting assumption means for a revenue slot (D09) is not part of this item, and priors on money slots stay as they are.

tickets.outcome: A tenant publishes its money policy in the learn document, and from then on a revenue or margin slot learns from outcomes in that currency on every path, live and in every offline fold alike, while the SDK no longer invents a currency the page never named.

criteria.observable: The learn document carries a money member, money: { currency, nonpositive } (the existing MoneyPolicy shape, src/learn/fan.ts:622–627: the currency the slot's money counters are in, and nonpositive one of refuse and credit): a new learn document with a well-formed member is published and read back with it; a malformed one (a currency that is not a non-empty code, a nonpositive outside the two words, an unknown key) is refused 422 naming the member; a retained revision that carries a malformed member reads with it dropped, as P36's and P11's members are; LearnConfig names it (src/content/types.ts:856). Today validateLearnConfig (src/content/kinds.ts:1660) and validateRetainedLearn (:1837) keep only the members they know, so a money member is accepted and dropped (_evidence/parity-step3/S47/engine/VERIFY.md §1 Engine 18, REPRODUCED: ok true, keptMoney false), and no type names it.
criteria.proof: The P103 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P103.MP1 in src/units/P103/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, the published policy reaches the money rule on every outcome path: outcomeToLearning (src/learn/route.ts:225–229), prepareOutcomeAdmission (:129–132) with the managed recovery's prepare body (src/ledger/recovery.ts:301–304, the plan's digest then covering it) and its admit call (:325), and the ring's outcome body (src/durable-objects/DecisionRing.ts:306, the money field at :142). With a policy of EUR: an outcome naming EUR is credited on a revenue slot and on a margin slot, one naming GBP is refused money_policy_unset naming GBP, and nonpositive refuse and credit each behave as named, through the direct path and with LEDGER_RECOVERY_ENABLED set through the managed recovery path alike. Today no producer passes a policy (route.ts:228 passes none; recovery.ts:325 passes undefined), so with any currency named the ring refuses (moneyRefusal, src/learn/fan.ts:638–656, :648): REPRODUCED through outcomeToLearning, a purchase and an add_to_cart naming EUR leaving both money slots empty (_evidence/parity-step3/S47/engine/VERIFY.md §1 Engine 18).
criteria.proof: The P103 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P103.MP2 in src/units/P103/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: One credit rule: the money rule (moneyRefusal) sits inside the shared credit rule (successCreditOf, src/learn/policy.ts:115–149) that the visitor's ring (src/durable-objects/DecisionRing.ts:626–640), foldRetainedDay (src/learn/fan.ts:1417) with the W24 rebuild that calls it (src/durable-objects/LearnStats.ts:1160–1167), the hourly fold (src/learn/hourly.ts:1351) and the raw grids (src/learn/report.ts:1431) all read, each reading the policy the outcome was decided under, carried on its record from the producer's own learn read (never the learn document in force when it is folded, R-P576, R-P588); so online and offline refuse and credit the same outcomes, with no policy (an outcome naming a currency refused everywhere) and with one (credited everywhere in its currency), when a policy is published between an hour's outcomes and its fold, and when the SDK retries an outcome (the same event id) on either path, before or after a publication: the retry is the same outcome, credited once live and folded once, under its first stamp, and the hour's fold and the day build as they would without it, on both hosts (R-P594). Today, besides the money rule, a retry on the direct path is a second outcome: its admission stamp differs, so live learning credits it twice and the hour's fold refuses with conflicting rows under one logical id (S50/specifier/REPORT-46cb4300.md). Today the ring alone applies the rule (DecisionRing.ts:626) and the offline folds weigh value with no currency check (creditWeight, policy.ts:109–113): REPRODUCED, foldRetainedDay credits the EUR purchase the ring refuses (_evidence/parity-step3/S47/engine/VERIFY.md §1 Engine 18), so the report and a rebuild credit revenue that live learning refused.
criteria.proof: The P103 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P103.MP3 in src/units/P103/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: The SDK sends a currency only when the page names one: a data-layer purchase whose ecommerce block names no currency is sent with none, and one that names a currency is sent with it unchanged; the bundles regenerated by node scripts/build-sdk.mjs, within their budgets (packages/sdk/package.json:33–37: 117,760 and 112,640 bytes; 115,707 and 110,212 at b11b1643) and W40.P3's rule (src/units/W40/LEDGER.unit.test.ts:455), build-sdk.mjs --check exiting 0. Today the GA4 mapping sends currency: x.currency ?? 'USD' (src/sdk/emit.ts:121), so every purchase the SDK reads carries a currency and, with no policy, every revenue or margin slot refuses it.
criteria.proof: The P103 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P103.MP4 in src/units/P103/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: Kit 02's money paragraph (docs/kit/02-api-reference.md:1124–1135) states the money policy as built: the learn document's money member and its two fields, that a tenant publishes its own values, what is refused and named with and without a policy, that live learning and the report credit the same outcomes, and that the SDK sends a currency only when the page's data layer names one; its sentences "none can be published yet" and "A purchase the SDK reads from the page's data layer always carries a currency (USD when the data layer names none)" are gone.
criteria.proof: The P103 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P103.MP5 in src/units/P103/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision, and the reviewer reads the changed sentences at that revision.

criteria.observable: LOCK, on both hosts: a slot whose objective is unit counts every event whatever currency it names (moneyRefusal answers null for unit, src/learn/fan.ts:640); with no money policy published every money slot refuses as today (W24 B1, B2 and LEDGER pass unchanged); imported priors on a money slot are still refused as today (priorUnitErrors, src/learn/priors.ts:264–276; the owner's decision D09 is not part of this ticket); P16's one rule, P33's per-slot attribution, W26's page-scoped statistics and P94's counter pass unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P103 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P103.MP6 in src/units/P103/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: Lane L21 on the pair's next release (the stamps read-only): on a pair tenant the lane may publish to, its learn document published with a money policy of EUR (the lane's own value for the walk), an SDK purchase naming EUR credits a revenue slot live (the outcome receipt names no money refusal) and the day's report credits the same outcome; one naming another currency is refused by name live and absent from the report alike.

tickets.title: The learning report's fold, with a fixed memory bound per step (**amendment 13, E29, 2026-10-28**)

authority.locator: E29 · section 2 of amendment 13, "Done when" (inserted from _evidence/parity-step3/S50/AMENDMENT-13-E28-E29.md; the verification S47/engine, Engine 20, R-P557; the design S49/analyst-report-fold, R-P561; in force under the owner's direction, R-P545)
authority.requirement: the hourly fold and the day report work in fixed-size steps (a plan, partition pages, leaves of visitors that split as they grow, a merge tree, a close), every step holding at most 64 MiB whatever the traffic, measured in the harness at 10,000, 100,000 and 1,000,000 visitors a day; on the same records the result equals today's fold; an hour is committed by two conditional writes, so no hour is lost or counted twice and a failed run resumes; the day report is summed one hour at a time and stored by slot, a day whose grids pass 8 MiB answering 200 by slot, never 413; the W24 rebuild folds with the 200-entry ring and the previous day's carry-in, as the hourly fold and live learning do; kit 02 states the envelope.

tickets.outcome: A tenant's learning report folds every hour and builds every day at any traffic, in steps of a fixed size, with the same numbers today's fold gives, no hour lost, counted twice or left incomplete, and a day read by slot instead of refused 413.

criteria.observable: The bound, on both hosts in the harness: every step of the hourly fold and of the day report (plan, partition, leaf, merge, close, day; the open hour and the custom-policy day taking the same steps) holds at most 64 MiB at 10,000, 100,000 and 1,000,000 visitors a day, with fixed inputs per step: a partition page at most 16 MiB and 200 objects; a leaf at most 8 MiB of state and 8 MiB of rows (a leaf that would pass 8 MiB splits by visitor hash, moving only its own visitors); a merge at most 64 partials; a day one hour aggregate and the running total. A step past its bound is refused naming its step (fold_step_bound); every object of an hour is read, in pages, so no hour is truncated; the wide context of the design's T5 folds, the cells bound kept per slot at the live table's capacity (256 items, 4,096 counters, src/durable-objects/LearnStats.ts:38–39) times the policies. Measured on the prototype: at most 56 MiB at all three volumes, a leaf's peak hour 0.2–0.3 s (_evidence/parity-step3/S49/analyst-report-fold/DESIGN.md §5; _evidence/parity-step3/S49/analyst-report-fold/logs/proto.jsonl V1, V2). Today one request holds the hour's rows twice, all 64 shards' rings and an inline copy of every new shard body under REPORT_LIMITS (src/learn/report.ts:27–31) and the staged-body cap (src/learn/hourly.ts:2716, :2729–2739): an hour refused above about 8,900 decisions (rawBytes, observed 16,938,953), the next hour once the rings pass 3.69 MiB (aggregateBytes), an hour at 40 visitors on cells, and past 600 objects an hour truncated (MAX_HOUR_OBJECTS, hourly.ts:78) (_evidence/parity-step3/S49/analyst-report-fold/DESIGN.md §2, REPRODUCED).
criteria.proof: The P104 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P104.RF1 in src/units/P104/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: Parity, on both hosts: on the same records the staged fold at depth 0 equals today's buildHour (src/learn/hourly.ts:2555) value for value and shard for shard: the 64 shard states equal (byte-identical where the state is encoded as today's v2), the hour aggregates and the day reports equal to a relative 1e-15, duplicates counted alike, across two hours with crossing visitors, duplicates spanning pages, a filed conflict, an erasure, an expired stamp, a re-fold of a grown hour and an earlier hour folded after a later one. The prototype matched today's fold on two hours: aggregates to 1.1e-15, all 64 shard states byte-identical after hour 13, the day reports equal, duplicates 200 and 200 (_evidence/parity-step3/S49/analyst-report-fold/DESIGN.md §4, _evidence/parity-step3/S49/analyst-report-fold/logs/proto.jsonl E1, REPRODUCED).
criteria.proof: The P104 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P104.RF2 in src/units/P104/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: The commit, on both hosts: an hour is committed by two conditional writes, the hour aggregate (create-only on a first fold, on the etag the plan noted for a re-fold) and then the state head naming the new leaf versions and clearing the in-flight plan; a crash after each step and between the two writes leaves no hour lost and none counted twice; of two concurrent coordinators one wins and the other adopts or stops; a newer hour waits while a plan is in flight. Today the commit stages every new shard body inline in shard zero's pending plan (src/learn/hourly.ts:2729–2739; finishHour, :2258–2275), which is what caps the rings.
criteria.proof: The P104 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P104.RF3 in src/units/P104/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: Resume, on both hosts: a failed run (a step that throws or is cut off) resumes from the outputs already present, found by one listing per 1,000 outputs, only the missing steps re-run; a filed conflict re-runs only its own leaf (today the whole hour, src/learn/hourly.ts:2117–2128); an abandoned generation's unnamed outputs are collected after a 15-minute grace; a store written by today's code (64 shards, an interrupted v2 plan) is first finished by today's finishHour and cleanupHourlyState and then continued by the staged fold with identical next-hour results.
criteria.proof: The P104 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P104.RF4 in src/units/P104/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: The day report, on both hosts: summed one hour at a time (measured at most 17 MiB) and stored as today's summary frame, a head and one part per slot, so GET with ?slot= reads only its slot's part; a day whose grids pass 8 MiB (outputBytes) answers 200 with the head and a slot index, grids by slot, never 413; a 1,000,000-visitor day is built complete from 24 hours; an old single-JSON day still reads (src/learn/report.ts:388–398). Today any budget answers 413 (src/routes/decisions.ts:2046–2049), 24 hours of 868 KB aggregates are refused (aggregateBytes 17,357,910), and a refused hour leaves the day 200 with coverage incomplete and the hour missing (_evidence/parity-step3/S49/analyst-report-fold/DESIGN.md §2 T4, T4b, REPRODUCED).
criteria.proof: The P104 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P104.RF5 in src/units/P104/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

Today foldRetainedDay folds an uncapped one-day ring with no carry-in (src/learn/fan.ts:1395–1403) under the records cap of 50,000 (src/learn/report.ts:27).
criteria.proof: The P104 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P104.RF6 in src/units/P104/LEDGER.unit.test.ts and they pass, and the program integration gate command exits 0 at the same artifact revision.

criteria.observable: Kit 02 states the report as built: the supported envelope (no volume limit on the fold; the per-step bound), the day read by slot (?slot=) and the 200 by slot past 8 MiB in place of 413, coverage, and the open hour's deferral as today (open_fold_deferred).
